title: Inter’s 2025/26 third kit released - and it’s another Total 90-style bangerShare on FacebookShare on XShare on Reddit
text:
Inter and Nike have dropped their new third kit for the 2025/26 season – a Total 90-inspired design that revives one of Nike’s most iconic templates from the 2000s.

The shirt keeps the trademark T90 aesthetic, complete with the centralised crest and framed chest panel, but this time it arrives in a colourway never before seen at San Siro: a bold Thunder Grey base cut through with striking Safety Orange trims.

Inter have long used orange in their third shirts, but rarely as a secondary tone. Here, it works in dramatic fashion, with the bright accents sparking brightly against the darker tones as they run along the neckline, sleeves and crest border.

The retro-style cuffs, finished with the classic T90 pattern, only add to the nostalgia, while Nike’s latest Dri-FIT ADV technology brings modern comfort, breathability and freedom of movement.

The kit will debut on September 21 when Inter face Sassuolo in Serie A, and is available now via Nike, the club’s official online store, and select retailers worldwide.

With Chelsea, Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain also receiving their own T90 remixes this season, Inter’s version stands tall as a retro throwback that captures the joy and free-flowing expression of 2000s football – exactly the kind of energy the Nerazzurri will hope to channel on the pitch.
